query_text: Create a horizontal bar chart showing the top 8 Fintech ecosystems by the absolute value of `rank mismatch = rank by Ecosystem Value - rank by seed purchasing power`, where `seed purchasing power = Median Seed Round / Software Engineer Salary`, expressed in `absolute rank positions`, sorted descending by the absolute rank gap, and excluding ecosystems where `Total Early-Stage Funding` is `<$50 m`.

plot_spec.title: Fintech 2020 Value Rank vs Seed Purchasing Power Rank Gap
